text: OVERDOSAGE Occasional incidents of acute overdosage of Nitrofurantoin Oral Suspension, USP have not resulted in any specific symptoms other than vomiting. Induction of emesis is recommended. There is no specific antidote, but a high fluid intake should be maintained to promote urinary excretion of the drug. It is dialyzable.
